items.name: specific speed Ns (Balje, dimensionless)
items.consequence: outside the radial-stage sweet spot the achievable efficiency falls; low Ns = narrow exit, high Ns = mixed-flow territory

items.name: specific diameter Ds
items.consequence: Cordier line: Ns*Ds ~ 2-2.5 for radial compressors

items.name: Ns*Ds (Cordier)
items.consequence: off the Cordier line the impeller is over- or under-sized for its duty

items.name: L1 efficiency estimate vs Balje achievable band
items.consequence: achievable ~0.856 at this Ns; a higher claim needs justification, a lower one leaves performance on the table

items.name: slip factor disagreement between methods (max-min)
items.consequence: each 0.01 of slip is ~1 % of work: a 3 % spread is a 3 % pressure-ratio uncertainty until CFD/test settles it

items.name: de Haller number W2/W1rms
items.consequence: below ~0.65 the inducer-to-exit deceleration separates the suction surface

items.name: diffusion ratio W1s/W2
items.consequence: above ~1.9 the shroud-side flow stalls (Dixon); below 1.4 the impeller is lightly loaded (heavy)

items.name: Coppage diffusion factor D_f
items.consequence: blade-to-blade loading: above 0.6 the blade-loading loss and wake grow rapidly

items.name: work coefficient psi = dh/U2^2 (Euler)
items.consequence: high psi = radial blades and wide operating-range penalty; low psi = tip speed used inefficiently

items.name: inducer shroud relative Mach
items.consequence: above ~1.25 shock losses and choke margin erode; below 0.9 the inducer is larger than it needs to be

items.name: exit width ratio b2/D2
items.consequence: narrow exits lose efficiency to clearance and friction; wide exits promote exit-flow separation

items.name: inducer incidence range along the running line (max - min)
items.consequence: a wide incidence swing means the inlet metal angle cannot suit both idle and max power

items.name: vaned-diffuser incidence at the lowest converged speed
items.consequence: large positive incidence at low speed = diffuser stall = low-speed surge

items.name: vaneless gap r3/r2
items.consequence: too small: impeller/vane interaction, noise, forced response; too large: friction loss

items.name: vane throat / (pitch cos alpha3) at design
items.consequence: a throat smaller than the free-stream opening chokes; much larger means the vane LE is not aligned with the flow

items.name: vane leading-edge incidence at design (L2 swirl)
items.consequence: positive incidence eats the stall margin, negative the choke margin

items.name: diffuser inlet Mach (vaneless exit)
items.consequence: transonic vane inlets are loss- and range-sensitive

items.name: vaneless-space swirl angle alpha3
items.consequence: above ~75-78 deg the vaneless space itself stalls (Senoo); below 60 the impeller exit is heavily blocked

items.name: two-zone exit mixing loss / impeller exit dynamic head
items.consequence: wake/jet mixing before the vanes; grows with wake fraction (loading, clearance, low Re)

items.name: Smith-chart placement: efficiency contour at (psi, phi)
items.consequence: loading/flow coefficient combination away from the 0.9+ island costs stage efficiency directly

items.name: stage loading psi
items.consequence: above 2 the rotor turning and losses grow; below 1.3 the annulus is short

items.name: flow coefficient phi
items.consequence: outside 0.5-0.8 the velocity triangles skew and secondary losses rise

items.name: rotor Zweifel coefficient (actual)
items.consequence: too many blades = friction/blockage; too few = separation on the suction side

items.name: NGV Zweifel coefficient (actual)
items.consequence: as above for the nozzle row

items.name: hub reaction (free vortex)
items.consequence: negative hub reaction = hub-section diffusion in the rotor = separation

items.name: exit swirl |alpha3|
items.consequence: exit swirl is lost kinetic energy in the jet pipe and loads the tail cone

items.name: rotor trailing-edge blockage t_te/o
items.consequence: thick trailing edges on small blades: mixing loss ~ 0.5 (t/o) of the exit head

items.name: rotor-exit Mach
items.consequence: high exit Mach wastes turbine work in the jet pipe; the nozzle then dominates the running line

items.name: nozzle throat / turbine exit annulus area
items.consequence: small ratio = high turbine exit Mach and a running line pushed toward surge; large = unchoked nozzle, thrust-lapse sensitive

items.name: rotor hub/tip ratio
items.consequence: long blades: stress and tip-clearance sensitivity; short: clearance losses

combustor1d.uncertainty_note: pattern factor, blow-out and wall temperature: +/-30 % model-form uncertainty (Lefebvre correlations)

life.uncertainty_note: life numbers carry a factor-of-3 scatter (applied in the verdicts)

impeller_machining.note: 5-axis milled from forged/rolled billet: full handbook allowables

bom.part_number: RS PRO K-type M8 probe 3 mm x 25 mm

instrumentation.sensor: optical / magnetic pickup on the shaft nut
load cell in the thrust frame
pitot rake at the deswirl exit
static taps + thermocouple in the bellmouth

abort_criteria: vibration > 40 um pk at the housing
bearing temperature > 450 K or rising > 5 K/s
fuel pressure loss or flame-out (EGT drop > 100 K/s)

requirements.name: thrust target inside supported range
requirements.note: above 1000 N a single centrifugal stage needs OPR/size outside the calibrated range

requirements.name: design Mach subsonic (pitot intake model)
requirements.note: supersonic design points use a normal-shock recovery; check intake separately

cycle.name: OPR within single-stage centrifugal practice
cycle.note: above ~5 a single backswept impeller needs U2 > 600 m/s

cycle.name: T04 within uncooled cast-wheel practice
cycle.source: IN-713LC/MAR-M247 uncooled rotor practice (JetCat/AMT class 1050-1200 K)
cycle.note: above 1250 K an uncooled wheel is creep-life limited; check MECH turbine rules

cycle.name: compressor exit temperature vs aluminium impeller limit (info)

speed.name: inducer shroud relative Mach at design
speed.note: lower rpm, larger hub/tip ratio or higher inlet Mach margin

speed.name: design rpm vs turbine AN2 limit
speed.source: AN2 with IN713LC allowable 436 MPa at 1030 K, margin 1.25
speed.note: lower rpm, stronger turbine material, or lower T04

speed.name: design rpm vs turbine disc bore-stress limit
speed.source: bored IN713LC wheel, allowable 631 MPa at 750 K, k_peak 1.3
speed.note: lower rpm, smaller hub/tip target, boreless wheel or stronger material

speed.name: design rpm vs bearing DN limit
speed.note: smaller journal (if torque allows), hybrid bearing, or lower rpm

speed.name: impeller tip speed allowed by material (info: set by work, see COMP-3)

compressor.name: inducer shroud relative Mach
compressor.note: reduce rpm or raise hub/tip ratio

compressor.name: impeller tip speed U2
compressor.note: lower OPR, less backsweep, more blades, or accept a stronger material

compressor.name: exducer root stress at MCS vs allowable (root sized to the limit)
compressor.note: root thickness capped at 20 mm: reduce U2 or backsweep, or change material

compressor.name: impeller material temperature (Tt3)
compressor.note: compressor exit too hot for this material: lower OPR or change material

compressor.name: exit width ratio b2/D2
compressor.note: raise phi2 or backsweep, or lower rpm

compressor.name: relative diffusion ratio W1s/W2
compressor.source: Dixon & Hall / Rodgers: W1s/W2 <= ~1.8-2.0 for attached flow
compressor.note: raise phi2 (wider exit), more backsweep, or reduce inducer Mach

compressor.name: inducer throat choke margin at design
compressor.source: Rodgers: design at <= 90 % of throat choke flow (boomsonic A3R.5)
compressor.note: thinner LE, fewer main blades, larger hub/tip or lower inducer relative Mach

compressor.name: inducer throat not choked at design
compressor.note: the inducer throat is choked: lower rpm / relative Mach or open the throat

compressor.name: radius ratio r2/r1s
compressor.note: rpm too high for the required work: reduce rpm

compressor.name: radius ratio r2/r1s upper
compressor.note: rpm too low: raise rpm or hub/tip ratio

compressor.name: diffuser inlet flow angle from radial
compressor.note: more backsweep or higher phi2 to reduce swirl

compressor.name: implied diffuser total-pressure loss
compressor.note: impeller_eta_offset too large or eta_c assumption too low

turbine.name: stage loading psi
turbine.source: Smith chart: efficiency falls fast above ~2.2
turbine.note: raise rpm (larger Um) or accept lower efficiency

turbine.name: stage loading psi minimum
turbine.source: below ~1.2 the annulus becomes very short

turbine.name: rotor-exit hub/tip ratio
turbine.note: too long blades: raise psi target or rpm

turbine.name: blade root stress at MCS x margin vs allowable
turbine.source: IN713LC min(yield, creep) at 1030 K; margin 1.25
turbine.note: lower rpm, shorter blades (higher psi/hub-tip), stronger material or lower T04

turbine.name: rotor metal temperature vs material limit
NGV metal temperature vs material limit
turbine.note: NGV sees T04 directly; use a higher-temperature alloy or lower T04

turbine.name: rotor exit absolute Mach
turbine.source: jet-pipe entry Mach; boomsonic R7.1 annulus cap

turbine.name: AN2 (rotor annulus x rpm^2) at MCS
turbine.source: uncooled cast wheels: JetCat/AMT class 2-3.5e7, ceiling ~4.5e7 m2 rpm2

combustor.name: reference velocity
combustor.note: casing annulus too small: raise diffuser radius ratio or shrink the tunnel

combustor.name: liner length / height
combustor.note: long liner: raise U_ref or liner height

combustor.name: liner metal temperature margin (T04 vs liner T_max; film-cooled liners run cooler)
heat release rate
combustor.source: large annular 20-60, micro-turbojet vaporiser combustors up to ~300 MW/(m3 bar)
combustor.note: raise residence time or liner volume

layout.name: bearing span / D2 (rotordynamic sanity)
layout.source: long spans lower the bending critical; boomsonic_v0 1.43
layout.note: shorten the combustor (higher U_ref / residence) or move the rear bearing aft

rotor.name: bearing DN at MCS vs rating
rotor.note: larger-DN (hybrid, oil-air) bearing, smaller journal, or lower rpm

rotor.name: first bending critical / MCS
rotor.note: stiffer/larger tube, shorter span, lighter overhung wheels

rotor.name: rigid-body criticals below 60 % speed (soft mount)
rotor.source: traverse rigid modes below idle-to-cruise band
rotor.note: stiffer mounts move rigid modes up; keep them below idle or add damping

rotor.name: shaft tunnel fits inside combustor inner casing
rotor.note: smaller tube or larger combustor inner radius

mechanical.name: impeller disc peak stress at MCS vs yield
mechanical.source: Ti-6Al-4V min-basis yield at 441 K; k_peak 1.6
mechanical.note: lower U2 (OPR/backsweep), boreless mount, or a stronger material

mechanical.name: impeller burst speed ratio
mechanical.note: reduce average tangential stress: thicker hub, lower U2

mechanical.name: inducer root radial stress vs yield
exducer root stress (from compressor stage, sized to limit) vs allowable
turbine disc peak stress vs bore allowable
turbine disc average stress vs rim creep allowable
impeller clamp load retained hot
mechanical.source: tie-shaft preload minus thermal relaxation and gas load >= 20 % of preload
mechanical.note: higher preload, longer tie shaft, or a matched-expansion sleeve

maps.name: design-point surge margin (loss-model map, SAE definition)
maps.source: rig-calibrated stall model (HECC/CC3); band +/-7.7 SM points
maps.note: more backsweep, larger vaneless gap, fewer / lower-solidity diffuser vanes, or a lower running line

maps.name: design-point choke margin (flow to choke / design flow - 1)
maps.source: inducer / diffuser throat choke on the design speed line
maps.note: open the inducer or diffuser throat

maps.name: L2 loss-model compressor efficiency vs L1 estimate |diff|
maps.note: L2 0.830 vs L1 0.807: consider `jet ingest` of the L2 value or check inputs

maps.name: L2 loss-model turbine efficiency vs L1 estimate |diff|
compressor loss-model PR at design vs cycle OPR |diff|/OPR
maps.source: the sized geometry should deliver the cycle pressure ratio within the loss-model accuracy
maps.note: loss model PR 4.271 vs cycle OPR 4.000

offdesign.name: minimum surge margin along the running line
offdesign.source: SAE margin from the L2 map at N 0.40; band +/-7.7 SM points (rig-calibrated)
offdesign.note: lower the running line (larger nozzle), more backsweep, or a bleed / variable geometry

offdesign.name: max-thrust point recovers the design thrust
offdesign.note: max thrust 492 N vs design 500 N (T04-limited)

envelope.name: fraction of envelope grid points cleared (converged, SM >= floor)
envelope.note: see the envelope table for the failing corners

envelope.name: worst-case surge margin over the envelope
envelope.source: at alt 7000.0 m, M 0.3, dT -20.0 K; band +/-7.7 pts
envelope.note: hot-day / high-Mach corners load the compressor: consider a variable nozzle or bleed

envelope.name: sea-level static max thrust vs design thrust
envelope.source: envelope max-power point at SLS (T04- or N-limited)

transient.name: start reaches idle
transient.note: more starter torque, earlier light-off or richer start schedule

transient.name: minimum surge margin during the slam acceleration
transient.source: transient excursion toward surge; band +/-7.7 SM points

transient.name: T04 peak during acceleration vs limit
transient.source: over-temperature limiter (the limiter holds the peak at the limit)

transient.name: hung start with half starter torque avoided
overspeed on governor failure (peak N / design)
transient.source: burst margin 1.2 x MCS must cover the overspeed reached before the fuel cut

assess.name: compressor quality score (mean of items)
assess.note: AQ-C5 slip factor disagreement between methods (max-min) = 0.0563; AQ-C12 inducer incidence range along the running line (max - min) = 17.5; AQ-C2 specific diameter Ds = 2.99; AQ-C4 L1 efficiency estimate vs Balje achievable band = -0.0493

combustor1d.name: primary-zone equivalence ratio
combustor1d.source: Lefebvre: primary zone phi 0.8-1.4 for vaporiser combustors

combustor1d.name: primary-zone Damkohler number (residence/chemical)
combustor1d.source: Da >> 1 required for stable combustion (global kinetics; order of magnitude)

combustor1d.name: combustion efficiency (Lefebvre theta correlation)
combustor1d.source: theta correlation calibrated on the fleet (+/-2 pts)
combustor1d.note: larger liner volume, higher P3, or better mixing

combustor1d.name: lean blow-out margin at design (phi_pz / phi_LBO)
combustor1d.note: richer primary zone or larger primary volume

combustor1d.name: lean blow-out margin at idle
combustor1d.source: Lefebvre stability loop at the idle point
combustor1d.note: raise idle speed or the deceleration fuel floor

combustor1d.name: pattern factor into the turbine
combustor1d.source: Lefebvre: PF 0.2-0.35 for short annular liners

combustor1d.name: liner wall temperature vs material limit
combustor1d.note: more film cooling, thermal barrier coating or IN625 -> Haynes 230

combustor1d.name: altitude relight index (phi_LBO windmilling / phi_LBO design)
combustor1d.note: relight needs a rich start schedule or a lower relight altitude

life.name: turbine blade creep life over the mission / scatter

life.name: turbine disc rim creep life / scatter
impeller bore LCF cycles / scatter
